dialogue_texts: Oh, My Majesty, thank you so...
I simply couldn't let such an unsightly closed door ruin the aesthetic of my borders.
Your intervention knocked the curse out of me.
It was less of an intervention and more of a forced reopening.
Now, where is the amateur architect who built this mental prison?
Ah, so you're the one trying to "file away" my citizens.
I hope you've prepared your defense; a royal audit is rarely pleasant.
You're useless now, Fusana. And so is that pathetic fushinja queen there...
Please deal with her, My Majesty.
Time for me to finish both of you.
I was here before the Order was a whisper, and I'll be here long after you've been swept into the gaps of history.
Escape? You misunderstand. I'm not trapped in here with your glohm.
I'm simply deciding which boundary to use to erase you.
The Federal Kingdom of Gensokyo is mine.
The kingdom belongs to the balance of reality, not the stagnant silence of a maid with a grudge.
You will be destroyed after you found a way to rid the glohm from her.
A bold prediction. But I specialize in the impossible.
Let's see if your grey despair can survive the beauty of a quadruple barrier!
You will be destroyed, your remains will be used to build something new, and that soul will destroy all of Gensokyo.
